elements.manual_reason: The run (play) toolbar icon changes tint after the selection; no candidate box covers it.
elements.label: Run report icon

pattern.description: The cursor moves down the open version list from Budget Pass 1 to Working Budget (hover highlight follows), clicks, and the dropdown snaps shut leaving Version 1 set to Working Budget and the run icon highlighted.
pattern.why_premium: A real, unhurried click path with the hover highlight visible lets the viewer follow the exact selection, and the instant close keeps the beat tight before narration moves on.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {y:'+=24', duration:0.3, ease:'power1.inOut'}); tl.set('.dropdown li.hover', {className:'+=hover'}, '<0.15'); tl.set('.dropdown', {autoAlpha:0}, '+=0.1'); tl.set('.version1 .value', {textContent:'Working Budget'}, '<'); tl.to('.run-icon', {color:'#f39200', duration:0.1}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); dropdown opacity = frame >= clickFrame ? 0 : 1 (hard cut); swap the selector label on the same frame; no spring.

notes: Energy is a single-frame spike (hard state change), so the dropdown close is a cut, not an animated fade. The cursor also moves but has no candidate box and was not listed. Run icon tint change is subtle; verify.
